name: analysis_v3_audio_language_grounded_qa_v1

questions.text: Describe the major arrangement changes over this selected passage.
What instruments or musical layers become more or less prominent here?
What changed between the first selected span and the second selected span?
Summarize the production and timbral character of this passage.
What musical features make these selected passages feel related?
State the exact chord substitution in this passage. If the supplied evidence cannot establish it, say so rather than guessing.

annotation_protocol.unit: one model answer to one question under one condition
annotation_protocol.grading_rule: Do not use the evaluated model to grade its own factual correctness. Prefer blinded human/manual claim-level annotation against supplied evidence and known benchmark facts.
annotation_protocol.temporal_rule: Mark temporal_grounding_correct only when a claim is localized to the correct selected/adjacent span; do not infer timestamp precision from prose.

notes: Question manifest only. Audio/evidence cases are attached by a future runnable model evaluation; this file does not invent ground truth or model outputs.
